fact: Decree n°2022-0639/PT-RM of 3 November 2022, instituting the biometric national identity card, cites Law n°06-040 of 11 August 2006 (the NINA law) among the texts it rests on, as a law in force at that date; the document is itself a decree, not a law.
system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

fact: Decree n°2022-0639/PT-RM of 3 November 2022, made citing Law n°06-040 and its 2006 decree, requires the NINA number for any first or renewed biometric ID card application, which police, gendarmerie and sub-prefects issue; it also states the card replaces the NINA card by right.
system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

fact: Decree n°06-442/P-RM of 18 October 2006 is made to apply Law n°06-040 of 11 August 2006 instituting the national identification number NINA for persons and legal entities, which it cites as in force.
system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

fact: Decree n°06-442/P-RM of 18 October 2006 fixes how Law n°06-040 applies: the structure of the 14-digit NINA, the data held, how it is attributed, transmission of civil-status data, and an obligation on named public services, embassies and consulates to use the NINA and show it on their documents.
system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

fact: Law n°06-040 of 11 August 2006, adopted by the National Assembly on 13 July 2006 and promulgated by the President, institutes the national identification number NINA for persons and legal entities and a national identification register; it is an ordinary law.
system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

fact: Law n°06-040 of 11 August 2006 states the NINA individualises each person with a unique number, held in a national identification register run by the national statistics service, and to be shown on the ID card, passport and civil-status records.
system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)
